evidence.detail: Model.q() computes one normalized triangle cross-product, then for smooth-shaded faces adds the same XYZ components into rs/S at each of the face's three vertex indices and increments the fourth component by one for each contribution.
Model allocates rs/S using the model vertex count and indexes it with face vertex indices, while the class stores exactly four integers per entry: accumulated X, Y, Z and contribution count.

The lighting pass reads the accumulated XYZ components for each vertex, forms the light-vector dot product, and divides by a scale multiplied by the fourth rs/S component before computing the per-vertex shade.

candidates.note: VertexNormalBuffer names the packed per-vertex accumulated normal storage used by Model's smooth-shading pipeline; it is a semantic role name, not an original-identifier claim.
